items.text: The all-windows stash well needs no more work: Mac shows it only during a drag, and T2313 already does that.
A Linux relaunch in single-window mode brings back the workspace that was on show.
The Linux app can now report what a live window resize costs per frame.
The Linux build compiles again: pane-seen's draw reset no longer shadows its own flag.
resize-frame-cost.sh reads the draw block where the seam puts it.
A person can read the Linux app's frame costs off a real WSLg drag.
Record the green docs-routing and doc-claims runs over the Linux quality-bar note.
On Linux a quit whose window teardown hangs in Mesa's d3d12 driver now ends the process anyway, so SIGTERM always quits.
A folding card's face now reports where it hands its name to the strip, and stack-fold-slide fails if the name would jump.
